purpose: Non-admission public-source research: cross-border building and property value priors, insurer product mix, government impact benchmarks and overlooked ground-instability layers; no source-data bytes, rights, science or CAT model admission.

entries.name: Belgian FPS Finance cadastral building condition statistics, 2026 vintage
entries.provider: Belgian FPS Finance, General Administration of Patrimonial Documentation
entries.spatial_scope: Belgium; national, regional, province, arrondissement, municipality, cadastral division and statistical sector aggregates; no building-level insured-site claim
entries.temporal_scope: 2026-01-01 technical vintage; official catalogue metadata revised 2026-07-24; annual series
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Downloadable zipped CSV by type of built parcel, including totals, physical-condition indicators, central heating and pre-1900 construction; administrative and statistical-sector class summaries
entries.note: Official FPS Finance geo.be catalogue offers 2026-01-01 ZIP CSV, geographic classes and links to French/Dutch terms. Its linked French licence explicitly defines 'plan cadastral' (cadastral map), so do NOT silently infer that it also licenses these building-condition statistical tables or relabel it CC BY 4.0. Product-specific statistical reuse/commercial and derived-data terms remain unknown pending publisher clarification. Parcel totals are not building totals, dwellings, insured risk locations or replacement values. Acquire and SHA-pin exact ZIP only outside public Git after rights/provenance review.

entries.name: Belgian FPS Finance real estate transactions by cadastral geography
entries.provider: Belgian FPS Finance, General Administration of Patrimonial Documentation
entries.spatial_scope: Belgium; seven published administrative/cadastral geography levels down to statistical sectors
entries.temporal_scope: Quarterly maintained series; provider technical specifications identify 2025-06-30 vintage; exact current downloadable extract to be version-pinned
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Zipped CSV with real estate transaction counts and market values by type of property/right and cadastral nature, aggregated geographically
entries.note: Official geo.be catalogue specifies original 2025-06-30 ZIP and transaction technical specification; it links to a bespoke French/Dutch cadastral-plan licence, not an explicit CC BY 4.0 grant for the transactions table. Specific re-use rights for these statistical CSVs need authoritative scope review before distribution or commercial modelling. Cadastral transaction values concern selected transferred interests and include market/land components; never equate with total stock, replacement TIV, policy contracts or insured locations.

entries.name: France Cerema DVF+ geolocated real-estate transactions
entries.provider: Cerema and DGALN, based on French DGFiP property transaction data
entries.spatial_scope: France with DVF geographic/legal exclusions and cadastral-geocoding coverage; not a nationwide inventory of every existing building
entries.temporal_scope: Historical five-year rolling DVF transaction source; Cerema data product updated during 2026, exact download release to be pinned
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Transaction-level DVF+ database and cadastral localisation; source page advertises CSV/Shapefile or PostgreSQL/PostGIS distribution routes
entries.note: Official Cerema portal identifies Licence Ouverte/Open Licence v2.0, but underlying DGFiP DVF rules warn against indirect reidentification and search-index exposure. Validate current asset endpoints, exact version, rights and aggregation before use.

entries.name: UK FCA general insurance value measures 2025 by firm and retail product
entries.spatial_scope: United Kingdom reporting firms and retail products; firm-by-region building exposure and insured-address locations are not supplied
entries.temporal_scope: Reporting year 2025; published 2026-07-21 and updated 2026-09-11; underlying fixed snapshot 2026-05-05
entries.resolution_or_granularity: FCA-published XLSX with product/firm level claims frequency, acceptance, average paid amount and complaints; market product-level claims-cost/premium ratios
entries.note: FCA source is the 2025 firm/product Value Measures publication, with direct provider XLSX at https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/data/gi-value-measures-data-2025.xlsx (publication/link verified, original XLSX bytes not obtained). Firm product reporting applies above GBP400k written retail premiums AND above 3000 in-force policies; home buildings/contents aggregate claim costs are 48 percent of premiums but individual firm statistics do not identify natural-peril claims, risk locations or TIV. FCA explicitly warns of home acceptance-rate reporting inconsistency and post-snapshot corrections. Rights to distribute/downloaded workbook require independent verification.

entries.name: Indonesia BNPB post-disaster rehabilitation and reconstruction damage-loss proposals 2017-2024
entries.provider: Indonesia National Disaster Management Authority (BNPB), Directorate of Rehabilitation and Reconstruction Planning
entries.spatial_scope: Indonesia province and district-level reported rehabilitation/reconstruction proposal records; event and geographic completeness must be measured
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Government CKAN catalogue offering year-wise XLSX damage and loss amount tables, province/district, event year and disaster category fields where present
entries.note: Amounts originate from local-government rehabilitation and reconstruction submissions; they must not be equated with independently verified paid insured claims, final damage cost or ground-up CAT loss. Catalogue lists multiple XLSX resources; exact resource IDs, vintages, file hashes and licence need independent verification. BNPB DIBI event maps already have a separate source candidate; this is a distinct loss-proposal product.
